issue_context.title: Retention time of 2 hours not working as intended
issue_context.body: **What did you do?** Run prometheus server, in k8s, with 2 hours of retention and a block duration of 2h (recommended by Thanos). Thanos is taking care of long term retention, 30 days. **What did you expect to see?** You should only be able to see data until 2 hours ago. **What did you see instead? Under which circumstances?** Data from 5h30 ago was available to query. This will cause Prometheus to consume more resources, for metrics which already have been store by Thanos. ![Screenshot 2021-10-26 at 12 34 08](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25937180/138869685-6a96be11-8b08-4009-b4eb-fb89d181f71e.png) Here you can see two blocks (01FJXX7WWQ3XTYBD91YB0PRYNB and 01FJY43KWNY079Y2F45P2YKTAS) and the current chunks. I expected to see one closed block but not two of them. Logs show that only the oldest block is being deleted every 2 hours. Output of meta.json of the oldest block (01FJXX7WWQ3XTYBD91YB0PRYNB): ``` { "ulid": "01FJXX7WWQ3XTYBD91YB0PRYNB", "minTime": 1635228002003, -> Tuesday, 26 October 2021 06:00:02.003 "maxTime": 1635235200000, "stats": { "numSamples": 127266331, "numSeries": 271257, "numChunks": 1057748 }, "compaction": { "level": 1, "sources": [ "01FJXX7WWQ3XTYBD91YB0PRYNB" ] }, "version": 1 } ``` Output of meta.json of the latter block: ``` { "ulid": "01FJY43KWNY079Y2F45P2YKTAS", "minTime": 1635235200708, "maxTime": 1635242400000, "stats": { "numSamples": 133698907, "numSeries": 282855, "numChunks": 1112227 }, "compaction": { "level": 1, "sources": [ "01FJY43KWNY079Y2F45P2YKTAS" ] }, "version": 1 } ``` **Environment** * Prometheus version: 2.29.1 * Prometheus configuration file: ``` prometheus comments: `>=`  looks fine. Note that it will will still leave you with of `5h` of data at peak for any retention `<5h`. This is because the retention is calculated w.r.t. the last block, so there will be at least 1 block of 2h plus upto 3h of data in the head block. (Currently with `>` instead of `>=` you will have 2 blocks and 3h of head, hence peack data range being `7h`).
@codesome 2h 1 block + 2h of the head block, at most, is what totally makes sense and I'm fine with it. Thanks guys!

review_comments: I would like a little explanation what is going on here - why these 4 blocks, why in this order, what are we expecting.
